answer: A kernel is bought, not lent. Each identity claims one kernel per key — the seat carrying its vote — by burning 20 POA per claim. Each epoch the kernel lights an ember: the seated key signs the roll's fresh nonce within 60 seconds. Lottery raven auditors replay one kernel in six, flagging misses or shared signatures. A dead ember revokes the kernel — weight zeroed, key benched two epochs — re-entry burns another 20 POA. Fakes buy seats per head: N fakes × 20 POA = 20N POA burned. Limit: honest seats pay the same.
